title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-10

ai_review.summary: Beefy, clarified sound‑board capture (minor clipping) of a fire‑filled 1973 show with monster Eyes of the World, Dark Star and Bird Song.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑engineered SBD is praised as crystal‑clear, beefy and virtually flawless – only a hint of clipping and one minute of reel‑change loss that’s been patched.  The performance itself is described as an epic, high‑energy marathon with standout jams on Eyes of the World, Dark Star, Bird Song, Morning Dew and the long‑running Bird Song/Playing in the Band sequence, earning it a place among the best of ’73.  Overall listeners are ecstatic about both the music and the transfer.

ai_rating.rationale: 20 reviews (17 five‑star, 3 four‑star) uniformly praise the show’s energy and the Miller soundboard upgrade; only minor technical quibbles appear, yielding an overall rating near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Beefy, clarified audio with very little clipping; Miller’s upgrade removes hiss and adds punch. One‑minute reel gap was patched by a reviewer. A few listeners note the sound is slightly dry/sterile compared to audience tapes, but overall it is considered superb fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: An 8‑hour marathon (≈4 hr 34 min) that moves fluidly from a tight first set into sprawling second‑set jams and a climactic third set; transitions are praised as seamless.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for shredding solos, “Garcia’s tone” and his improvisational fire on Dark Star, Eyes of the World and the extended jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for powerful bass (“Phil bombs”), good separation in the mix and solid support throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Praised for vocal contributions (Weir) and rhythm guitar work; several reviewers mention his singing on songs like Jack Straw and Here Comes Sunshine.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s harmonies are highlighted, especially during Bird Song and other vocal‑rich passages.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann receives compliments for “jazz drumming” and keeping tight time throughout the long improvisations.
